summary: Full backend E2E test for Bisca. All auth endpoints, room APIs, WebSocket chat/start_game, and a full 3-player game (13-card round down through iterative 1-card final elimination) completed successfully. Winner declared and user stats persisted in MongoDB.
passed: GET /api/auth/me works with Bearer AND cookie
POST /api/rooms/create requires auth (401 without) and returns code
WS /api/ws/{code}?token=... broadcasts 'state' messages to all connected players
Full happy path: bidding (dealer-last constraint respected via auto-adjust), playing, trick_reveal, continue_trick, round_end, next_round progression across all 13 rounds
Final 1-card round: viewer's own card returned with hidden=true while others' cards visible
in_final_elim_phase toggled after first 1-card round; iterative 1-card rounds proceeded
Game reached phase='finished' with a winner
User stats.games_played incremented to 1 in MongoDB after game end
Re di Denari card (denari-10) handled via play_card with re_denari_as_zero param (also re_denari_choice path exists in code and is exercised when arg omitted)
notes: Test script at /app/tests/test_bisca_backend.py. One noisy log line 'FAIL: round -> round_end :: phase=finished' is a test-script assertion false-positive: the last round transitioned directly to terminal 'finished' state (correct game behavior) rather than 'round_end'. Winner and stats persisted correctly.
